description: Get every new public change on a tracker, a person's trackers or a whole site (e.g. nike.com) POSTed to an https URL as signed JSON ({type: "network.change", id, change: {id, url, title, previousValue, currentValue, summary, origin, publishedAt, watch, hunter}}). Verify X-Monity-Signature = "sha256=" + hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, X-Monity-Timestamp + "." + raw body); the secret is returned here as signing.secret. Retries on 5xx/429/timeouts; a 410 unsubscribes. Needs a write-scope API key. Max 25 per account.

targetRef.description: A tracker's slug or id, a person's handle, or a site such as nike.com

targetType.description: What to follow: WATCH (a tracker with one source) or WATCHLIST (a tracker with several), HUNTER (a person) or SITE

url.description: https address on the public internet

name: subscribe_network_webhook
title: Subscribe a webhook to Network changes
